name: @schemavaults/mail-server
description: Manages the SchemaVaults mailing list, sending to the list, mail templates, and sending transactional emails.

scripts.dev:app: bun run auth-codegen && PORT=5346 SCHEMAVAULTS_APP_ENVIRONMENT=development NEXT_PUBLIC_SCHEMAVAULTS_APP_ENVIRONMENT=development next dev
scripts.build: bun run auth-codegen && SCHEMAVAULTS_APP_ENVIRONMENT=production NEXT_PUBLIC_SCHEMAVAULTS_APP_ENVIRONMENT=production next build
scripts.migrate:development: bun run build:migrations && npx @schemavaults/dbh migrate ./dist/migrations --environment development --env-file .env.development
scripts.migrate:test: bun run build:migrations && npx @schemavaults/dbh migrate ./dist/migrations --environment test --env-file .env.test
scripts.migrate:production: bun run build:migrations && npx @schemavaults/dbh migrate ./dist/migrations --environment production --env-file .env.production
